list.name: vin
list.label: VIN
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vin AS __text, vin AS __value FROM telemetry ORDER BY 1

list.name: dist_effective
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN '$dist_unit'='metric' THEN 'metric' WHEN '$dist_unit'='imperial' THEN 'imperial' WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(distance_unit, 'DistanceUnitKm') FROM vehicle_prefs_pivot WHERE vin = '$vin')='DistanceUnitMiles' THEN 'imperial' ELSE 'metric' END

list.name: temp_effective
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN '$temp_unit'='fahrenheit' THEN 'imperial' WHEN '$temp_unit'='celsius' THEN 'metric' WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(temp_unit, 'TemperatureUnitC') FROM vehicle_prefs_pivot WHERE vin = '$vin')='TemperatureUnitFahrenheit' THEN 'imperial' ELSE 'metric' END

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", model_year AS "Year", motor_config AS "Motor", has_heat_pump AS "Heat Pump", has_air_suspension AS "Air Suspension" FROM detect_vehicle_from_vin('$vin')

panels.title: Decoded VIN: $vin
panels.description: Vehicle information decoded from the selected VIN using the detect_vehicle_from_vin() database function.

panels.title: Drawn from AC supply (30d)

targets.rawSql:
WITH vals AS (
  SELECT num_value, LAG(num_value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE field = 'ACChargingEnergyIn' AND vin = '$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND num_value IS NOT NULL
)
-- per-session counter: a fall below half the previous value is a new session,
-- a smaller dip is parked drift and adds nothing
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prev IS NULL THEN 0
                         WHEN num_value < prev * 0.5 THEN num_value
                         WHEN num_value < prev THEN 0
                         ELSE num_value - prev END), 0) AS kwh
FROM vals

panels.description: ACChargingEnergyIn: energy taken from AC supplies (wall box, outlet) at the onboard charger's input. Not counted for DC fast charging.

panels.title: Into battery (30d)

targets.rawSql:
WITH vals AS (
  SELECT num_value, LAG(num_value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prev
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE field = 'DCChargingEnergyIn' AND vin = '$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND num_value IS NOT NULL
)
-- per-session counter: a fall below half the previous value is a new session,
-- a smaller dip is parked drift and adds nothing
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prev IS NULL THEN 0
                         WHEN num_value < prev * 0.5 THEN num_value
                         WHEN num_value < prev THEN 0
                         ELSE num_value - prev END), 0) AS kwh
FROM vals

panels.description: DCChargingEnergyIn: energy delivered into the battery by any charger — the onboard charger during AC charging and the station during DC fast charging. In an AC session this is the AC supply figure minus the charger loss.

panels.title: Regen while driving (30d)
panels.description: Energy returned to the pack while driving: positive pack power (PackVoltage × PackCurrent, 1-minute averages) inside trips, integrated over the real time between samples. Charging is excluded because it never happens inside a trip.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  -- per-minute pack power from the 1-minute aggregate; + = into the battery
  SELECT v.bucket, v.avg_v * i.avg_v / 1000.0 AS kw
  FROM telemetry_1m v
  JOIN telemetry_1m i ON i.vin = v.vin AND i.bucket = v.bucket AND i.field = 'PackCurrent'
  WHERE v.vin = '$vin' AND v.field = 'PackVoltage' AND v.bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
), d AS (
  -- each minute weighs the real time until the next sample, at most 5 min
  SELECT bucket, kw,
         LEAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(bucket) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) - bucket)), 300) / 3600.0 AS h
  FROM m
), drv AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM d
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.vin = '$vin'
                  AND d.bucket >= date_trunc('minute', t.started) AND d.bucket <= t.ended)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, kw) * h), 0) AS kwh FROM drv

panels.title: Drive energy out of pack (30d)

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  -- per-minute pack power from the 1-minute aggregate; + = into the battery
  SELECT v.bucket, v.avg_v * i.avg_v / 1000.0 AS kw
  FROM telemetry_1m v
  JOIN telemetry_1m i ON i.vin = v.vin AND i.bucket = v.bucket AND i.field = 'PackCurrent'
  WHERE v.vin = '$vin' AND v.field = 'PackVoltage' AND v.bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
), d AS (
  -- each minute weighs the real time until the next sample, at most 5 min
  SELECT bucket, kw,
         LEAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(bucket) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) - bucket)), 300) / 3600.0 AS h
  FROM m
), drv AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM d
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.vin = '$vin'
                  AND d.bucket >= date_trunc('minute', t.started) AND d.bucket <= t.ended)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, -kw) * h), 0) AS kwh FROM drv

panels.description: Gross energy taken from the pack while driving (negative pack power inside trips), integrated over real elapsed time; parked loads are excluded. Drive energy minus regen is close to the trips view's kwh_used (55.2 vs 58.9 kWh over 30 days on the production data when this was written).

panels.title: Distance (30d)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN '$dist_effective'='imperial' THEN COALESCE(MAX(num_value) - MIN(num_value), 0) ELSE COALESCE(MAX(num_value) - MIN(num_value), 0)*1.60934 END)::numeric, 1) AS dist FROM telemetry WHERE field='Odometer' AND vin='$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

panels.description: Total distance driven over the last 30 days, derived from odometer deltas.

panels.title: Power

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  v.bucket AS time,
  v.avg_v * i.avg_v / 1000 AS power_kw
FROM telemetry_1m v
JOIN telemetry_1m i ON v.bucket = i.bucket AND v.vin = i.vin
WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
  AND v.vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(v.bucket)
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Pack power from 1-minute averages: positive = into the battery (charging, regen), negative = out of the battery (driving, parked loads).

panels.title: State of Charge

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, last_v AS soc FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='BatteryLevel' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Battery state of charge trend over the selected time range.

panels.title: Charge Curve (Power vs SoC, last 7d)
panels.description: Charging power (positive pack power above 1 kW outside trips) against state of charge, 1-minute averages, last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pw AS (
  SELECT v.bucket, v.avg_v * i.avg_v / 1000.0 AS kw
  FROM telemetry_1m v
  JOIN telemetry_1m i ON i.vin = v.vin AND i.bucket = v.bucket AND i.field = 'PackCurrent'
  WHERE v.vin = '$vin' AND v.field = 'PackVoltage' AND v.bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT s.avg_v AS soc, pw.kw AS power_kw
FROM pw
JOIN telemetry_1m s ON s.vin = '$vin' AND s.bucket = pw.bucket AND s.field = 'BatteryLevel'
WHERE pw.kw > 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.vin = '$vin' AND pw.bucket >= date_trunc('minute', t.started) AND pw.bucket <= t.ended)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drive efficiency by speed bucket (Wh/km, 30d)

targets.rawSql:
WITH pw AS (
  SELECT v.bucket, v.avg_v * i.avg_v / 1000.0 AS kw
  FROM telemetry_1m v
  JOIN telemetry_1m i ON i.vin = v.vin AND i.bucket = v.bucket AND i.field = 'PackCurrent'
  WHERE v.vin = '$vin' AND v.field = 'PackVoltage' AND v.bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
), s AS (
  SELECT bucket, avg_v AS mph FROM telemetry_1m
  WHERE vin = '$vin' AND field = 'VehicleSpeed' AND bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND avg_v > 0
)
-- net consumption (out minus regen) per km, by speed band
SELECT width_bucket(s.mph, 0, 80, 8) * 10 AS speed_mph_bucket,
       SUM(-pw.kw) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mph * 1.609344), 0) * 1000 AS wh_per_km
FROM pw JOIN s ON s.bucket = pw.bucket
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Net energy per km (pack discharge minus regen, 1-minute averages) for minutes in each speed band, last 30 days.

panels.title: Charge Sessions

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, started, ended, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM duration)/60 AS minutes FROM charge_sessions WHERE vin='$vin' AND started > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY started DESC

panels.description: List of recent charge sessions with start, end, and duration.

panels.title: Driving activity (14d × 24h, avg drive power)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', v.bucket) AS time,
       GREATEST(0, -AVG(v.avg_v * i.avg_v) / 1000.0) AS power_kw
FROM telemetry_1m v
JOIN telemetry_1m i ON i.vin = v.vin AND i.bucket = v.bucket AND i.field = 'PackCurrent'
WHERE v.vin = '$vin' AND v.field = 'PackVoltage' AND v.bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Average pack discharge power per hour (1-minute aggregates; negative pack power = out of the battery), last 14 days.

panels.title: Pack temperature spread (min / max)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, to_temp(avg_v, '$temp_effective') AS min_c FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='ModuleTempMin' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket AS time, to_temp(avg_v, '$temp_effective') AS max_c FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='ModuleTempMax' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Minimum and maximum battery module temperatures over time.

panels.title: Pack voltage / current

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_v AS voltage FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='PackVoltage' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket AS time, avg_v AS current FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='PackCurrent' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Battery pack voltage and current over the selected time range.

panels.title: Lifetime Energy Used
panels.description: Total lifetime energy consumed by the vehicle (kWh).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts as time, num_value as value FROM telemetry_latest WHERE vin='$vin' AND field='LifetimeEnergyUsed'

panels.title: Charge Rate
panels.description: Miles of range added per hour while charging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts as time, CASE WHEN '$dist_effective'='imperial' THEN num_value ELSE num_value*1.60934 END as value FROM telemetry WHERE field='ChargeRateMilePerHour' AND vin='$vin' AND num_value IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
